chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Abdullah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) was asked, while I was in his presence, about a man who bought a slave girl and did not touch her. So his wife instructed his son, who was a boy of ten years, to have intercourse with her, and he had intercourse with her. So what is your view regarding it? He (peace be upon him) said: 'The boy has sinned, and his mother has sinned, and I do not view for the father, when the son has been near to her, that he should have intercourse with her.'

He (the narrator) said: 'And I asked him about a man who had a slave girl, so his father laid his hand upon her out of desire, or looked at her prohibited part out of desire. So he (peace be upon him) disliked that the son should touch her.'

key_terms.قَرِبَهَا: he was near to her / had intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on a ten-year-old boy having intercourse with a slave girl under his mother's instruction?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* elucidates the fiqh of *Istibda'* (exclusive ownership) regarding a father and son sharing a slave girl, highlighting the distinct legal liabilities of each party. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies that while the ten-year-old son and his mother incur sin for the act, the father is not religiously compelled to consummate the marriage if the son has already done so, preserving the son's exclusive right. Furthermore, it addresses the permissibility of the father touching the slave girl out of desire without invalidating the son's exclusive claim, provided he does not fully consummate the marriage.

en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al hakam, from Abdullah Bin Yahya Al Kahily who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> was asked and I was in his<sup>asws</sup> presence, about a man who bought a slave girl and did not touch her. So his wife instructed his son, and he was a boy of ten years that he falls upon her. So he fell upon her. So what is your<sup>asws</sup> view with regards to it?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The boy has sinned, and his mother has sinned, and I<sup>asws</sup> do not view for the father, when the son has been near to her, that he should fall upon her’.

He (the narrator) said, ‘And I asked him<sup>asws</sup> about a man who happened to have a slave girl for him, so his father laid his hand upon her out of desire, or looked at her Prohibited part out of desire. So he<sup>asws</sup> disliked that the son should touch her’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from ‘Abd Allah ibn Yahya al-Kahiliy who has said the following: “

Once abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, was asked, when I was with him (the Imam), about the case of a man who bought a slave-girl but did not touch her. His wife commanded his son, who was ten years old, to fall on her (for sexual intercourse) and he did it, now what do you say about it. He (the Imam) said, ‘The boy has sinned as well as his mother and it is not permissible for the father, after his son’s going near her, to fall on her.’

I then asked him (the Imam) about the case of a man who has a slave-girl and his father places his hand on her with lust or looks where it is not permissible to look with lust. He (the Imam) disliked his son’s touching her.’”
